about: The Android app's performance budgets, held by scripts/perf.ts on an emulator against a dev node with a busy fleet (apps/apple/scripts/dev-node.ts --heavy --auto-approve), reached with adb reverse. A number over its limit fails the run; where the iPhone's X2 target is not met yet, the limit holds what was measured from getting worse, and the target is checked too, its miss said in every run, never passed over. Measured 26 and 27 November 2026 (I12) on an Android 16 emulator on a MacBook shared with other work (its load said beside each): requests at rest 0 a minute (main: 122); a change on the node shown in 248-374 ms with a screen read of about 250 ms included (main: 1709-2926); a dead link said in 3.4-5.0 s (main: never) and back in 0.25-0.38 s; cold start (am start -W) about 1.3-2.1 s depending on the Mac's load, the same as main's alternately; Home scrolled 56-97 % janky frames, on main as here, the emulator starved by the Mac's other work. So start's limit is 2.5 s and its target 1 s; scrolling's limit 90 % janky and its target 10 %. Change a limit only on purpose, in its own reviewed change, saying why.
